author: Daedalus IV
title: Synergy Paper Gen. Test (2/2): Hard+Soft + Combat
abstract: This is the final generalization experiment for my paper on hard+soft feature selection synergy. Following the 'FWPCA+Combat' baseline (ID 1275), this submission tests the full synergistic method (Batch-Robust HVGs + FWPCA) on the simple Combat baseline. A positive result will demonstrate the generalizability of the synergy principle.
